```{r}
junctions_breast <- recount3::create_rse_manual(
    project = "BREAST",
    project_home = "data_sources/gtex",
    organism = "human",
    annotation = "gencode_v29",
    type = "jxn"
)
```
```{r}
sample_meta_breast <- as.data.frame(colData(junctions_breast))
junction_counts_breast <- assay(junctions_breast, "counts")
junction_coordinates_breast <- rowRanges(junctions_breast)
junctions_breast_mlh1 <- which(
    seqnames(junction_coordinates_breast) == "chr3" &
    strand(junction_coordinates_breast) == "+" &
    start(junction_coordinates_breast) >= 36970000 &
    end(junction_coordinates_breast) <= 37060000
)
junctions_breast_mlh1.1 <- junctions_breast[junctions_breast_mlh1, ]
junction_counts_breast_mlh1 <- assay(junctions_breast_mlh1.1, "counts")
junction_counts_breast_mlh1_df <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(junction_counts_breast_mlh1))
junctions_combined_breast_mlh1 <- data.frame(
    chr = as.character(seqnames(rowRanges(junctions_breast_mlh1.1))),
    start = start(rowRanges(junctions_breast_mlh1.1)),
    end = end(rowRanges(junctions_breast_mlh1.1)),
    strand = as.character(strand(rowRanges(junctions_breast_mlh1.1)))
)

junctions_combined_breast <- cbind(junctions_combined_breast_mlh1, junction_counts_breast_mlh1_df)
```

```{r}
duplicate_groups <- sample_meta_combined %>% group_by(gtex.subjid, gtex.smtsd) %>% filter(n() > 1) %>% arrange(gtex.subjid, gtex.smtsd) 
```

```{r}
sample_meta_combined_filtered <- sample_meta_combined %>%
  
  # 1. First remove exact duplicates within the same gtex.sampid
  group_by(gtex.sampid) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  # 2. Then resolve remaining replicate groups (same donor + same tissue)
  group_by(gtex.subjid, gtex.smtsd) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(recount_qc.junction_avg_coverage),
    desc(recount_qc.star.uniquely_mapped_reads_.),
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
merge_junctions_function <- function(df1, df2,
                             suffix1 = ".df1",
                             suffix2 = ".df2") {

  # Metadata columns
  meta_cols <- c("junction_id", "chr", "start", "end", "strand")

  # Full join
  merged_df <- full_join(
    df1,
    df2,
    by = "junction_id",
    suffix = c(suffix1, suffix2)
  )

  # Merge metadata columns
  for(col in c("chr", "start", "end", "strand")) {

    col1 <- paste0(col, suffix1)
    col2 <- paste0(col, suffix2)

    merged_df[[col]] <- coalesce(
      merged_df[[col1]],
      merged_df[[col2]]
    )
  }

  # Remove duplicated metadata columns
  cols_to_remove <- c()

  for(col in c("chr", "start", "end", "strand")) {
    cols_to_remove <- c(
      cols_to_remove,
      paste0(col, suffix1),
      paste0(col, suffix2)
    )
  }

  merged_df <- merged_df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      junction_id,
      chr,
      start,
      end,
      strand,
      everything(),
      -all_of(cols_to_remove)
    )

  # Replace NA with 0 in non-metadata columns
  non_meta_cols <- setdiff(colnames(merged_df), meta_cols)

  merged_df <- merged_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      across(
        all_of(non_meta_cols),
        ~replace_na(., 0)
      )
    )

  return(merged_df)
}
# per tissue group i equated the junctions that were not present in tissue group x but were present in the one or more of the other tissue groups to zero for the each sample of tissue group x
```

```{r}
junctions_eventclass_recount3 <- junctions_merged_recount3 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    donor_annotated    = !is.na(donor_exon),
    acceptor_annotated = !is.na(acceptor_exon),
    exon_diff = acceptor_exon - donor_exon,

    event_class = dplyr::case_when(

      donor_annotated & acceptor_annotated & donor_tx == acceptor_tx & exon_diff == 1 ~
        "normal splicing",

      donor_annotated & acceptor_annotated & donor_tx == acceptor_tx & exon_diff > 1 ~
        "exon skipping",

      donor_annotated & acceptor_annotated & donor_tx != acceptor_tx ~
        "cryptic donor/acceptor and canonical junction",

      !donor_annotated & acceptor_annotated ~
        "cryptic donor",

      donor_annotated & !acceptor_annotated ~
        "cryptic acceptor",

      !donor_annotated & !acceptor_annotated ~
        "novel",

      TRUE ~ "other"
    ),
    skipped_exons = dplyr::case_when(
      exon_diff > 1 ~ exon_diff - 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# create the columns samples_count_all, coverage_sum_all, coverage_avg_all and coverage_median_all 
sample_cols_merged_exonskipping <- colnames(merged_exonskipping)[25:ncol(merged_exonskipping)]

merged_exonskipping <- merged_exonskipping %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    samples_count_all = sum(c_across(all_of(sample_cols_merged_exonskipping)) >= 1, na.rm = TRUE),

    coverage_sum_all = sum(c_across(all_of(sample_cols_merged_exonskipping)), na.rm = TRUE),

    coverage_avg_all = {
      vals <- c_across(all_of(sample_cols_merged_exonskipping))
      vals <- vals[vals >= 1]
      if (length(vals) == 0) 0 else mean(vals)
    },

    coverage_median_all = {
      vals <- c_across(all_of(sample_cols_merged_exonskipping))
      vals <- vals[vals >= 1]
      if (length(vals) == 0) 0 else median(vals)
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  relocate(
    samples_count_all,
    coverage_sum_all,
    coverage_avg_all,
    coverage_median_all,
    .after = 24
  )
```

```{r}
dist_exact_simplest_model_exon12 <- merged_onerow_per_sample_exon12 %>%
  mutate(
    psi_sum = skipping / (skipping + total_inclusion),
    psi_bin = cut(
      psi_sum,
      breaks = c(
        0,
        0.001,
        0.005,
        0.01,
        0.02,
        0.05,
        0.1,
        0.2,
        1
      ),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(SMTSD, psi_bin) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(SMTSD) %>%
  mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n))

ggplot(dist_exact_simplest_model_exon12, aes(x = psi_bin, y = pct)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", width = 1) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct)),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 1.8
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ SMTSD) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 5, angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "PSI bin",
    y = "Percentage of samples within tissue"
  ) +
  ylim(0, max(dist_exact_simplest_model_exon12$pct) * 1.1)
```

```{r}
pairs_tmb_mainmodel_exon12_df <- as.data.frame(pairs_tmb_mainmodel_exon12)

# Filter Breast comparisons
pairs_tmb_mainmodel_exon12_df <- pairs_tmb_mainmodel_exon12_df %>%
  filter(grepl("Breast - Mammary Tissue", contrast))

# Compute effects + significance + modified labels
pairs_tmb_mainmodel_exon12_df <- pairs_tmb_mainmodel_exon12_df %>%
  mutate(
    odds_ratio = exp(estimate),
    percent_difference = (odds_ratio - 1) * 100,
    lower_ci = (exp(estimate - 1.96 * SE) - 1) * 100,
    upper_ci = (exp(estimate + 1.96 * SE) - 1) * 100,

    sig = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),

    # clean tissue label + add stars
    tissue = gsub(".*Breast - Mammary Tissue - ", "", contrast),
    tissue = paste0(tissue, sig)
  )

# Plot with stars in labels
ggplot(pairs_tmb_mainmodel_exon12_df,
       aes(x = percent_difference, y = reorder(tissue, percent_difference))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = lower_ci, xmax = upper_ci),
    height = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Percent difference in exon skipping odds vs Breast",
    y = "Tissue"
  )
```

```{r}
pairs_df <- as.data.frame(summary(contr_exon12, adjust = "BH"))

pairs_df <- pairs_df %>%
  mutate(
    odds_ratio = exp(estimate),
    percent_difference = (odds_ratio - 1) * 100,

    lower_ci = (exp(estimate - 1.96 * SE) - 1) * 100,
    upper_ci = (exp(estimate + 1.96 * SE) - 1) * 100,

    sig = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),

    # extract tissue name (Breast is already reference direction)
    tissue = gsub("Breast - Mammary Tissue - ", "", contrast),
    tissue = paste0(tissue, sig)
  )
pairs_df <- pairs_df %>%
  mutate(
    tissue = contrast,

    # remove only "(" and ")" but keep text
    tissue = gsub("[()]", "", tissue),

    tissue = trimws(tissue)
  )
pairs_df <- pairs_df %>%
  mutate(
    tissue = gsub("Colon - Sigmoid", "Colon (Sig)", tissue),
    tissue = gsub("Colon - Transverse", "Colon (Trans)", tissue),
    tissue = gsub("Small Intestine - Terminal Ileum", "SI (Ileum)", tissue),

    # optional simplifications
    tissue = gsub("Whole Blood", "Blood", tissue),
    tissue = gsub("Breast - Mammary Tissue", "Breast", tissue)
  )
pairs_df <- pairs_df %>%
  mutate(
    tissue = paste0(tissue, sig)
  )
    
ggplot(pairs_df,
       aes(x = percent_difference,
           y = reorder(tissue, percent_difference))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = lower_ci, xmax = upper_ci),
    height = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),  # tissue labels
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12)   # x-axis labels (optional)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Percent difference in exon skipping odds vs Breast",
    y = "Tissue"
  )
```

```{r}
emm_thisplot_exon12_covariats_df_recount3 <- emm_thisplot_exon12_covariats_df_recount3 %>%
  mutate(
    fold_vs_breast = breast_prob_exon12_covariats_recount3 / prob
  )
```

```{r}
plot_data <- merged_onerow_per_sample_exon12 %>%
  dplyr::select(SMTSD, inc_11_12, inc_12_13) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(inc_11_12, inc_12_13),
    names_to = "junction",
    values_to = "reads"
  )

ggplot(plot_data,
       aes(x = SMTSD, y = reads, fill = junction)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.3) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Tissue",
    y = "Canonical junction read count",
    fill = "Junction"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```

```{r}
tissue_order <- merged_onerow_per_sample_exon12 %>%
  mutate(total_inclusion = inc_11_12 + inc_12_13) %>%
  group_by(SMTSD) %>%
  summarise(
    median_total_inclusion = median(total_inclusion, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(median_total_inclusion)) %>%
  pull(SMTSD)

plot_data <- merged_onerow_per_sample_exon12 %>%
  dplyr::select(SMTSD, inc_11_12, inc_12_13) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(inc_11_12, inc_12_13),
    names_to = "junction",
    values_to = "reads"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    SMTSD = factor(SMTSD, levels = tissue_order)
  )

# Plot
ggplot(plot_data,
       aes(x = SMTSD, y = reads, fill = junction)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.3) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Tissue",
    y = "Junction split-read count",
    fill = "Junction"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```
